# ClickHouse

> > Fast open-source OLAP database and cloud service for real-time analytics, data warehousing, and high-performance SQL queries at scale.

ClickHouse is an open-source columnar database management system optimized for online analytical processing (OLAP), offering both self-hosted and cloud solutions. The platform features integrations with PostgreSQL, AWS, Cloudflare, and modern AI tools, with engineering leadership from co-founder and CTO Alexey Milovidov.

## Key Topics

- OLAP Database
- Real-Time Analytics
- ClickHouse Cloud
- Data Warehousing
- PostgreSQL Integration
- Observability
- Vector Search
- GenAI and Machine Learning
- ClickPipes (Data Ingestion)
- Materialized Views
- Open Source
- AWS and Cloud Integrations
- Performance Engineering
- Case Studies and User Stories
- ClickStack
